name: 4-HO-MCPT
summary: Novel synthetic tryptamine that is the cyclopropyl homologue of Psilocin. There is limited information on this drug.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-McPT produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents. It has been found to act as a serotonin reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: It has serotonergic effects, and has reportedly been sold as a designer drug since around 2016, but was not definitively identified by forensic laboratories until 2018.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. Lab work suggests it also blocks serotonin reuptake, which may add to serotonergic effects. In people at risk, these drugs can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。實驗室研究顯示它也會阻斷血清素回收，可能使血清素相關作用更強。對本身有風險的人，這類藥物可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。实验室研究显示它也会阻断血清素回收，可能使血清素相关作用更强。对本身有风险的人，这类药物可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its cyclopropyl group is a ring of just three carbon atoms. The bonds in such a small ring are bent far from their natural angle, which makes cyclopropane rings unusually strained and reactive.
fact.zh: 它的環丙基是只由三個碳原子組成的環。在這麼小的環中，化學鍵被彎折得遠離自然角度，使環丙烷環特別緊繃，也較容易起反應。
fact.zhHans: 它的环丙基是只由三个碳原子组成的环。在这么小的环中，化学键被弯折得远离自然角度，使环丙烷环特别紧绷，也较容易起反应。
